description: A Python script that sets up a Streamlit-based chatbot interface integrated with Langchain, SQL database, and various web search and math tools, for querying a 'schooldb' database and providing conversational responses.

methods.name: count_tokens
methods.description: A function that combines a prompt template with a user query, runs the chain, and handles token counting and exceptions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main function that initializes the Streamlit app, manages chat state, and processes user queries through the chatbot interface.
